answers.why: Ephraim has plural hearts and children and is promised collective restoration.
The broken brotherhood is between the communities of Judah and Israel.
The oracle concerns Israel in the coming siege of Jerusalem and Judah.
Judah is involved in the siege against Jerusalem as a territory and community.
Judah is the community whose tents are saved and whose glory Jerusalem must not surpass.
The house of Levi mourns as a family group with their wives.
Benjamin names a gate associated with the tribal territory in Jerusalem's geographical boundaries.
Malachi delivers the oracle to Israel, addressed collectively as 'you' in the next verse.
The command addresses the priests collectively to preserve God's covenant with Levi's priestly community.
Israel is the community in which an abomination is committed, alongside Jerusalem.
The God of Israel addresses the community about marital treachery.
All Israel received the law commanded through Moses at Horeb.
